name: Daily Draw
description: One card. One question. One moment of clarity.

positions.label: The Message
positions.description: What the day holds, or what you need to see right now.

name: Past · Present · Future
description: Three cards trace the arc of where you've been, where you are, and where you're heading.

positions.label: Past
positions.description: What has shaped this situation. Influences, foundations, what has passed.

positions.label: Present
positions.description: The current energy, the heart of the matter, where things stand now.

positions.label: Future
positions.description: The likely outcome if the current path continues. Not fixed — potential.

name: The Horseshoe
description: Seven cards in an arc for a fuller picture of influences, obstacles, and outcome.

positions.label: The Past
positions.description: Past influences still acting on the situation.

positions.label: The Present
positions.description: Where things stand today.

positions.label: Hidden Influences
positions.description: What is not immediately visible but is at work.

positions.label: Obstacles
positions.description: What stands in the way.

positions.label: Outside Influences
positions.description: People or forces from outside affecting the situation.

positions.label: Advice
positions.description: What the cards suggest you do.

positions.label: Outcome
positions.description: The likely result if the current path continues.

name: Celtic Cross
description: The classic ten-card spread. A deep, comprehensive reading of any question or situation.

positions.label: The Heart
positions.description: The core of the matter. The central energy or theme.

positions.label: The Cross
positions.description: What crosses or challenges you. An opposing or complicating force. (Placed sideways.)

positions.label: The Root
positions.description: The foundation. What lies beneath — subconscious influences or distant past.

positions.label: The Past
positions.description: What is passing away. Recent influences that are leaving.

positions.label: The Crown
positions.description: The best outcome possible. What you aspire to or could achieve.

positions.label: The Future
positions.description: What is approaching. The immediate next development.

positions.label: Your Position
positions.description: How you see yourself, or your attitude toward the situation.

positions.label: Outside View
positions.description: How others see you, or outside influences on the situation.

positions.label: Hopes & Fears
positions.description: What you hope for — or what you fear. Often both at once.

positions.label: The Outcome
positions.description: The final result. Where all these forces lead if the current path continues.

name: Year Ahead
description: Thirteen cards: one for each month, and a synthesis card for the year's overarching theme.

positions.label: January
positions.description: The energy and theme of the first month.

positions.label: December
positions.description: The energy and theme of the final month.

positions.label: The Year's Theme
positions.description: The overarching energy, lesson, or gift of the year as a whole.
